<?php
/**
 * SerializationEngine - PHP object serialization with Unicode support
 * Handles graceful shutdown to persist pending serialization queue
 */

class SerializationEngine {
    private $queue = [];
    private $normalizer;
    private $shutdownRegistered = false;
    private $storePath;
    private $allowedClasses;

    public function __construct(string $storePath, array $allowedClasses) {
        $this->storePath = $storePath;
        $this->allowedClasses = $allowedClasses;
        $this->normalizer = new UnicodeNormalizer();
        $this->registerShutdown();
    }

    private function registerShutdown(): void {
        if (!$this->shutdownRegistered) {
            register_shutdown_function([$this, 'flushQueue']);
            $this->shutdownRegistered = true;
        }
    }

    public function enqueue(string $key, $data): void {
        $normalizedKey = $this->normalizer->normalize($key);
        $this->queue[$normalizedKey] = $data;
    }

    public function flushQueue(): void {
        if (empty($this->queue)) return;
        
        $payload = serialize($this->queue);
        $tempFile = $this->storePath . '.tmp';
        file_put_contents($tempFile, $payload, LOCK_EX);
        rename($tempFile, $this->storePath);
        $this->queue = [];
    }

    public function restore(): array {
        if (!file_exists($this->storePath)) return [];
        
        $raw = file_get_contents($this->storePath);
        if ($raw === false || $raw === '') return [];
        
        return $this->safeUnserialize($raw);
    }

    private function safeUnserialize(string $data): array {
        // Validate structure before deserializing
        $validated = $this->validateSerializedPayload($data);
        if (!$validated) return [];
        
        $result = unserialize($data, ['allowed_classes' => $this->allowedClasses]);
        return is_array($result) ? $result : [];
    }

    private function validateSerializedPayload(string $data): bool {
        // Must start with array marker
        if (strpos($data, 'a:') !== 0) return false;
        
        // Check for dangerous patterns - object injection prevention
        // Scan the RAW data directly without any transformation
        if (preg_match_all('/O:\d+:"([^"]+)"/', $data, $matches)) {
            foreach ($matches[1] as $className) {
                if (!in_array($className, $this->allowedClasses, true)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

class UnicodeNormalizer {
    /**
     * NFC normalization for cache keys
     */
    public function normalize(string $input): string {
        if (function_exists('normalizer_normalize')) {
            return normalizer_normalize($input, \Normalizer::FORM_C);
        }
        return $this->fallbackNormalize($input);
    }

    /**
     * Normalize Unicode in serialized strings to canonical form
     * This handles cases where Unicode combining characters might
     * be used to obfuscate class names in serialized data
     */
    public function normalizeSerializedString(string $serialized): string {
        // Process string values within the serialized format
        // Pattern: s:<len>:"<value>"; - normalize the value portion
        return preg_replace_callback(
            '/s:(\d+):"(.*?)";/s',
            function($matches) {
                $value = $matches[2];
                $normalized = $this->normalize($value);
                // Recalculate length after normalization
                $newLen = strlen($normalized);
                return 's:' . $newLen . ':"' . $normalized . '";';
            },
            $serialized
        );
    }

    private function fallbackNormalize(string $input): string {
        // Basic ASCII-compatible fallback - strip combining marks
        return preg_replace('/[\x{0300}-\x{036f}]/u', '', $input);
    }
}

class SafeDataObject {
    public $label;
    public $value;
    
    public function __construct(string $label, $value) {
        $this->label = $label;
        $this->value = $value;
    }
}

// Usage example
$engine = new SerializationEngine(
    '/var/cache/app/serialized_queue.dat',
    ['SafeDataObject']
);

// Restore previous session data
$previous = $engine->restore();

// Enqueue new data with Unicode keys
$engine->enqueue("caf\xC3\xA9", new SafeDataObject('Coffee', 4.50));
$engine->enqueue("nai\xCC\x88ve", new SafeDataObject('Simple', 1.00));
